candidates_selection_rule: Drawn only from the zero_arg_methods class; picked the 8 whose ## Returns text names a concrete type, arity or documented branch rather than a bare noun.
anomalies: obsolete_loose - obsolete_strict = 0 in this family: a sweep for every line containing 'obsolete' that is not exactly the uniform 'Obsolete. Superseded by [[X]].' header returned 0 hits, so the 'Obsolete for documents created in ...' / 'Obsolete and not superseded.' variant class this task was guarding against is simply empty here, and criteria A and B cannot disagree on IBody2.

IGetExcessBodyArray is the only zero-arg member that is also an in-process pointer (its ## Returns carries the marker) => it is excluded from zero_arg_methods by the 'non-pointer' clause; counting it would give 51, not 50.

54 of the 220 pages carry no '## Returns' section at all (33 of them obsolete), so pointer_returns can only ever be evidenced on the 166 pages that have one - a member with a pointer return but no Returns section would be silently uncountable.

The two 'Not implemented.' pages (GetSafeBody, IsSafe) are NOT marked Obsolete, so they are counted as live members (one zero-arg method, one property) even though the page text says the body/IsSafe always returns NULL/false.

Check3 is `kind: property` with signature `FaultEntity Check3 {get;}` while its two obsolete predecessors Check/Check2 are zero-arg methods => the Check -> Check3 transition changed shape (method to property), not merely the name.
DeleteFaces3's obsolete header reads 'Superseded by [[IBody2::IDeleteFaces4]]' but no IDeleteFaces4 page exists in this directory (the page is DeleteFaces4) => broken cross-reference.
The two obsolete DeleteFaces3 generations disagree on return type: DeleteFaces3 returns System.bool while IDeleteFaces3 returns void, although both document the same heal-option semantics.

IMaterialPropertyValues and MaterialPropertyValues are obsolete properties with no ## Returns section, yet both are counted in properties_no_paren because criterion F carries no obsolete exclusion - whereas criterion E explicitly does. This asymmetry is deliberate per the task text but is easy to misread as inconsistent counting.

Broken or typo'd See Also links read in passing: `IModelDocExtenstion::SelectAll` (IGetEdges), `IGetPrcoessedBodyWithSelFace` (GetSelectedFaceCount), `[[GetFirstSelectedFace Method]]` and `[[IGetVertices Method]]` without the interface prefix, `[[IBody2:CreateTrimmedSurface]]` with a single colon, and `Body2::IGetIntersectionEdgeCount` mis-prefixed as Body2 instead of IBody2.

Pages such as ICreatePsplineSurfaceDLL carry `ref` array parameters whose descriptions say 'Pointer to an array' without the official in-process wording, so they fall outside both C and D; I counted the literal string only, never the word 'Pointer'.
IOperations2's Remarks tell the reader to re-call `IBody2::Operations2` after a non-manifold error, i.e. the in-process page cross-references its own dispatch sibling by the non-I name.
